frequency_question: How often do central banks deploy temporary incremental reserve ratio tools during periods of sudden liquidity surges?
membership_rule: Includes explicit central bank announcements mandating an incremental or ad-hoc cash reserve ratio on incremental deposits. Excludes standard, permanent statutory reserve ratio changes.

cases.name: PBOC Reserve Requirement Ratio targeted/incremental adjustments during liquidity gluts

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named episodes representing distinct systemic liquidity absorption cycles using incremental reserve ratio mechanisms.
known_gaps: Excludes minor or unpublicized administrative liquidity tightening measures.
skeleton: Ad-hoc liquidity management episodes by major emerging market central banks facing capital inflow surges or demonetization-like shocks over 20 years, grouped by policy response cycles.
multiplier: 3 observed distinct policy deployment cycles across major emerging market central banks facing acute excess liquidity overhangs over a 20-year observation window.
validity_reason: Central bank toolkits and structural responses to liquidity gluts evolve slowly over multi-year regulatory regimes.
